answer: Agents stake a bonded deposit on a public knoll of reputation, and each epoch they must solve a rotating challenge tied to their stake. A sybil farm must fund and bond every fake identity separately, so forging N agents costs N times the stake plus challenge compute. Honest peers on the reef cross-attest randomly, while a light zephyr of gossip propagates slashing events fast, making mass identity duplication expensive and quickly visible.
